recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s album cover featuring a circular photographic inset of a four-man vocal group against a vibrant cobalt blue background, framed by a complex hierarchy of bold, multicolored typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular photo mask centered horizontally but weighted towards the bottom-left
Primary title text following the upper curve of the circular mask
Right-aligned tracklist block balancing the circular subject
High-contrast color palette of blue, yellow, and white
coreInvariants: Multifaceted typographic hierarchy using at least four distinct styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A circular photo of four men in suits occupies the lower-left quadrant, scaled to roughly 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular photo acts as the primary anchor, with the bold yellow title text providing the secondary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the curved yellow title, follows the circle down to the group, then moves right to the tracklist, and finally to the bottom artist name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of solid blue negative space provide breathing room for the dense typographic information.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background providing a high-saturation field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary display text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary information and the top banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue background with high-value (bright) text elements creates a punchy, commercial look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy slab serifs, condensed sans-serifs, and casual scripts.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extra-bold slab serifs with square terminals.
Secondary text uses a light, fluid script with connecting lowercase letters.
Tracklist uses a highly condensed, uniform-stroke sans-serif.
Artist name uses a wide, high-contrast serif with thin hairlines.

composition.relationshipToImage: Frames the top of the circle
Balances the circle on the left

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy slab serifs and delicate scripts/condensed sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif display style.
Matches the condensed sans-serif tracklist style.
Matches the mid-century casual script style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid cobalt blue background. Place a large circular photo in the lower-left quadrant featuring four men in dark 1960s suits against a light grey studio background. Add a white horizontal banner at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply yellow slab-serif text along the top curve of the circle. Add a right-aligned block of white condensed sans-serif text on the right side. Place a white script line between the title and the tracklist. Add the artist name in a wide serif font at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent, vibrant blue?
Is the main title text yellow and curved?
Is the tracklist right-aligned and condensed?
Is the photo contained within a perfect circle?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the photo
Specific font choices within the defined categories
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the circular photo.
Check that the yellow and white colors are bright and distinct against the blue.
Verify the 'Stereophonic' banner is present at the top edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid saturated background + Circular photo inset + Curved slab-serif title + Right-aligned condensed tracklist = Mid-century Pop Album Aesthetic.
